paired.method: Shared immutable weights, independent state caches, rotating and reversed order. Memory is measured in separate processes.

limitations: Xcode and xctrace are absent. Captures were inspected through metadata and kernel names, with live Metal dispatch counts. Per-kernel GPU timestamps were not replayed. Xcode replay remains optional research into the remaining latency.
Synchronized diagnostic phases alter scheduling. Separate process end-to-end latency is authoritative.
Later controls and rotating measurements show latency variation without identifying its cause.
Raw private results and GPU captures remain local under .ai/profile/raw.
